desc: 靛蓝金线烘焙质感，白底主图到研磨冲调指引的套图
name: 中烘拼配意式咖啡豆款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净立身包装拿下首图位
一秒交代核心卖点，用留空参数行承接烘焙与拼配主张
用侧面轮廓证明袋体折边与封口做工，消除包装疑虑
保留双栏箭头对比骨架，承接版本或包装演进的主张位
解释适配器具与研磨粗细的机制，把使用门槛讲清楚
用豆相亲微距与梯度标尺证明烘焙层级，质感说服
让买家把自己代入早晨第一杯的真实台面场景
用留空两栏表格承接冲煮配方位，把用法讲明白
平铺全景给出成品杯与礼赠氛围，扩展使用想象
让买家在同一画面里挑规格与形态，减少选错风险
以留空信息版式与空印章框收口，承接资质与溯源背书位

style.backgroundSystem: alternating seamless white cyclorama #FFFFFF, warm taupe gradient ground #BCA487 under a deep navy upper band #22305C split by one sweeping gold curve #C89A3C, and a plain deep navy panel #22305C for infographics
style.direction: premium roasted-coffee ecommerce, navy-and-gold package campaign
style.iconSystem: single-family thin cream #F2E6CE line icons with rounded terminals, one weight only, no filled pictograms except outline check badges
style.lightingSystem: warm-neutral studio light, soft key from the upper left with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle single-direction contact shadows, controlled sheen on foil, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium roasted-coffee ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy field #22305C, gold line accent #C89A3C, warm latte-taupe ground #BCA487 and clean white packshot base #FFFFFF; warm-neutral studio lighting with a soft upper-left key and single-direction contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family, headlines composited later; single-family thin cream line-icon style; background system alternating seamless white cyclorama, warm taupe gradient ground under a navy upper band split by one sweeping gold curve, and a plain navy infographic panel; stable upright pack angle and scale, product artwork never redrawn; blank ruled parameter lines and empty table cells instead of rendered copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no invented numbers or credentials in-image
style.presentationRules: pack stands upright and uncropped, identical slight 3/4 or straight-on reading angle across the family, stable scale, product artwork never redrawn, overlay graphics never painted onto the label
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm taupe pedestal and board, honed marble counter, white marble slab for overhead lay-downs
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, all headlines and labels composited later, in-image text carried only by blank ruled lines
